audioUrls.title: Audio or video file URLs
audioUrls.description: Direct links to audio/video files (mp3, wav, m4a, mp4, webm, ogg...), up to 500 MB each. Public Google Drive and Dropbox share links also work.

podcastFeeds.title: Podcast RSS feeds or Apple Podcasts links
podcastFeeds.description: Paste a podcast's RSS feed URL or its Apple Podcasts page (podcasts.apple.com/.../id123...). The newest episodes are transcribed.

episodesPerFeed.title: Episodes per podcast
episodesPerFeed.description: How many of the newest episodes to transcribe from each feed.

quality.title: Mode
quality.description: Accurate is better for Japanese, accents and noisy audio. Fast is about 3x quicker and half the price.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Pick the spoken language for best accuracy, or let Whisper detect it.

translateToEnglish.title: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Output English text and English subtitles from audio in any language. Use Accurate mode for the best translation quality.

wordTimestamps.title: Word-level timestamps
wordTimestamps.description: Add start/end times for every word (useful for karaoke-style captions and editing).

maxFiles.title: Max files
maxFiles.description: Safety limit on files/episodes per run.

maxMinutesPerFile.title: Max minutes per file
maxMinutesPerFile.description: Longer files are skipped and not charged.
